_note: Releases the desk expects, so the monthly Hotel loan watch and other scheduled notes can be prepared the day a window opens. Windows are [first day, last day] in given months. ALL TIMINGS ARE INFERRED from the research in docs/research/peer-voice.md and one or two observed release dates each; none was confirmed with the publisher. Correct them when you see the real dates.

entries.name: Trepp monthly CMBS readings (delinquency, special servicing, maturities)
entries.action: Draft the monthly Hotel loan watch from the new readings (see src/content/blog/_TEMPLATE-hotel-loan-watch.md).
entries.basis: Trepp's readings were reported early in the following month in 2026 coverage.

entries.name: KBRA CMBS Loan Performance Trends
entries.action: Read it for the lodging line and add it to the watch.
entries.basis: KBRA's October 2025 edition is dated October 31, 2025.

entries.name: CREFC monthly CMBS loan performance report
entries.action: Take the lodging special servicing line for the watch.
entries.basis: CREFC's June 2026 report was released July 28, 2026. One data point.

entries.name: FDIC Quarterly Banking Profile
entries.action: Bank-held loan data. Look for commercial real estate noncurrent rates.
entries.basis: The second-quarter profile came out in late August 2026.

entries.name: MBA commercial and multifamily delinquency report
entries.action: Check whether the release has a lodging line.
entries.basis: Second-quarter data was published July 30, 2026. One data point.

entries.name: Federal Reserve Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey
entries.action: Look at the commercial real estate lending standards and demand lines.
entries.basis: The latest survey was published around November 2, 2026.

entries.name: Hotel REIT and brand quarterly results
entries.action: Skim for loan repayments, refinancings, and franchise or improvement-plan comments.
entries.basis: One large hotel REIT reported third-quarter results on November 4, 2026. Others vary.
